hero.lead: I build full-stack products end to end: React and Next.js interfaces in TypeScript, the APIs and data behind them, and the infrastructure they run on. I designed and built the microservices platform at Moneta Market and co-founded the software studio Bifrost Code.

about.heading: About me
about.p1: Full stack engineer with {years}+ years of production experience: TypeScript front ends in React and Next.js, backends in Python and .NET, and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
about.p2: At Moneta Market I designed and built the microservices platform: six containers in production wiring together ML pipelines, event-driven webhooks and a C# desktop app, plus an on-device computer-vision pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson. When the lead developer left, I led the team's two interns. In parallel I co-founded Bifrost Code, a studio that ships full-stack products and self-hosts them on its own infrastructure.
about.location: Chihuahua, Mexico · Open to remote or US relocation

experience.heading: Experience
experience.monetaB1: Architected and shipped the company's first containerized platform: a six-service Docker Compose stack (two FastAPI microservices, Label Studio, MLflow and an Nginx reverse proxy) on AWS EC2, replacing manual deployment with reproducible automation.
experience.monetaB2: Designed the PostgreSQL schema the whole operation rests on: 25 tables on AWS RDS with 24 foreign keys, 34 strategic indexes, an idempotent migration system and soft-delete audit trail; access runs exclusively through an SSH tunnel via an EC2 bastion host.
experience.monetaB3: Built an event-driven FastAPI webhook service linking Label Studio to S3: atomic database/S3 rollback on any failure, async connection pooling and an in-memory cache with database fallback; wrote the team runbooks for operating it.
experience.monetaB4: Developed a cross-platform C# desktop app (.NET 10 with Avalonia, migrated off a Windows-only WPF build) for human review of model-labelled frames: MVVM architecture, two-pass verification workflow and a sliding-window prefetch cache.
experience.monetaB5: Implemented least-privilege IAM policies, moved credentials into AWS Secrets Manager and set up the CI pipelines; LocalStack emulates S3 locally so development never touches production credentials. Co-supervised two interns and led them after the lead developer's departure.
experience.monetaB6: Built the data pipeline's operator tooling — CLIs, idempotent S3-to-PostgreSQL sync, drift audits — and automated model training through GitLab CI on ephemeral AWS GPU instances with MLflow tracking.
experience.monetaB7: Built an on-device computer-vision pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano that counts and identifies the products a customer takes from a retail cooler: two-stage detection and classification on TensorRT FP16, multi-object tracking at 60 fps and automatic camera recalibration via SIFT homography; designed its evaluation harness (leave-one-day-out validation, pre-registered thresholds, stability tests), which established the frame-rate and image-format requirements for production.
experience.contractorB1: Deliver full-stack web applications end to end with React, Next.js, NestJS and Express, on TypeScript pnpm monorepos backed by PostgreSQL; earlier engagements shipped on React Native, FastAPI and Django.
experience.contractorB2: Three products shipped and still running for real clients: FisioApp (multi-tenant clinic management, audited against WCAG 2.1 AA), Feriu (multi-tenant shared-expense platform) and Karaoke Balu (real-time requests over SSE with kiosk mode).
experience.contractorB3: Self-host client applications on the studio's own infrastructure: a Proxmox VM running Ubuntu Server with Dokploy and Docker Compose health checks, DNS on Cloudflare and services exposed through Cloudflare Tunnels without a single inbound port — a low-cost alternative to Vercel or AWS.
experience.rogaB1: Maintained and extended the internal ERP running across more than 170 branches and used by over 1,750 employees (Mueblería El Pasito / Villarreal Muebles / Dinexpress), spanning point-of-sale, multi-branch inventory, pricing and accounts receivable modules in .NET Framework.
experience.rogaB2: Built from scratch the module managing the field agents who visit customer homes for credit approval: full design ownership, DevExpress map controls plotting assignments geographically, and data consumed from a companion Android app.
experience.rogaB3: Designed the SQL Server database architecture behind multi-branch retail operations: stored procedures for inventory aggregation and pricing logic, and others that composed the HTML emails with Chilkat and handed them to the delivery service, removing the manual report compilation step.
experience.contractorNote: Side project, alongside my full-time role

projects.heading: Projects
projects.scDesc: Computer vision for an unattended retail cooler: an on-device pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson that detects, tracks and identifies the products a customer takes, with the evaluation harness behind its production requirements.
projects.fisioDesc: Multi-tenant management for physiotherapy clinics: clinical records, appointments, packages and payments. Audited against WCAG 2.1 AA, with automated off-site backups via cron to Backblaze B2.
projects.feriuDesc: Multi-tenant, self-hosted shared-expense platform with a Splitwise-style settlement engine, built as a NestJS + Next.js pnpm monorepo on PostgreSQL.
projects.karaokeDesc: Real-time karaoke request platform for live events: an SSE-synced queue, admin panel, self-serve kiosk mode and Virtual DJ integration. Express + React monorepo.
projects.sdDesc: Custom dataset training for personalised image generation, exploring fine-tuning techniques for deep learning models.
projects.galagaDesc: Unreal Engine game controlled through a smartphone accelerometer, bridged with Processing and HTTP requests.
